sec: Leptospirosis: features, complications, diagnosis and treatment

items.q: Leptospirosis features — match — 1) Onset 2) Muscles 3) Eyes … A) Conjunctival congestion and suffusion B) Calf muscle tenderness C) Abrupt onset fever of low to intermediate grade
items.exp: 'Features : · Abrupt onset fever (Low to intermediate grade), myalgia — Calf muscle tenderness, Conjunctival congestion' and 'Conjunctival suffusion'. (Book p1057)

items.q: How is the fever of leptospirosis described on this page?
opts: Abrupt onset, low to intermediate grade
items.exp: '· Abrupt onset fever (Low to intermediate grade)'. (Book p1057)

items.q: Complications — match — 1) Hepatorenal syndrome 2) Renal lesion 3) Electrolytes … A) Non-oliguric AKI with hypokalaemia and hypomagnesaemia B) Hepatitis with jaundice plus acute tubular necrosis C) Thrombocytopenia
items.exp: 'Hepatorenal syndrome : Hepatitis with jaundice + Acute tubular necrosis'; 'Non-oliguric AKI with : 1. Hypokalemia, 2. Hypomagnesemia'; 'Thrombocytopenia'. (Book p1057)

items.q: Which electrolyte disturbances are printed under non-oliguric AKI in leptospirosis?
Immunological manifestations — match — 1) Cardiac 2) Neurological 3) Muscle … A) Myocarditis with secondary MR / AR, and aseptic meningitis B) Rhabdomyolysis C) Aseptic meningitis
items.exp: 'Immunological manifestations : myocarditis, · Secondary MR/AR, + Aseptic meningitis'; 'Rhabdomyolysis'. (Book p1057)

items.q: Which is NOT printed among the leptospirosis complications?
items.exp: Printed complications: hepatorenal syndrome, non-oliguric AKI with hypokalaemia and hypomagnesaemia, thrombocytopenia, myocarditis with secondary MR/AR, aseptic meningitis, ARDS and rhabdomyolysis. (Book p1057)

items.q: Which diagnostic criteria are printed for leptospirosis?
Which test is printed as the gold standard for leptospirosis?
items.exp: 'Gold standard test : microscopic agglutination test (MAT)'. (Book p1057)

items.q: Fill up (Treatment): 'Doxycycline + Inj Ceftriaxone ______ IV OD.'
items.exp: 'Treatment : Doxycycline + Inj Ceftriaxone 2g IV OD'. (Book p1057)

items.q: Which period does the page print as the vital period in leptospirosis?
A farmer presents with abrupt fever, tender calf muscles, conjunctival suffusion, jaundice and non-oliguric renal failure. Which diagnosis and confirmatory test does the page support?
opts: Leptospirosis — confirmed by the microscopic agglutination test
items.exp: The fever pattern page names leptospirosis in a farmer with calf myalgia and conjunctival suffusion; the gold standard here is MAT. (Book p1057)
